item.text: 关键异常已经形成闭环证据:AGG_SW_01到Core_SW_01的上联口被显式配置为BPDU过滤;随后该口的MST信息老化,且AGG_SW_01面向两台核心的端口在用户VLAN所属实例均同时处于FORWARDING,破坏了冗余三角中的阻塞关系。现在做最后一次MAC/流量侧核对以确认最小集合无需加入次生现象。

item.command: "C:\\windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe" -Command '$projectRoot='"'D:\\myWork\\github\\optimization-with-real-trajectory\\taowen\\saved_configs\\CampusNetwork_04'; Write-Output '[AGG_SW_01 MAC entries VLAN 120 and uplinks]'; Select-String -LiteralPath (Join-Path "'$projectRoot '"'AGG_SW_01\\display_mac-address.txt') -Pattern 'VLAN 120','120','HundredGigE1/0/1','HundredGigE1/0/2','HGE1/0/1','HGE1/0/2' -Context 0,1 | Select-Object -First 80 | ForEach-Object {"'$_.Line.TrimEnd()}; Write-Output '"'[Core path ports traffic counters proving loop load]'; foreach("'$node in @('"'Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02')){"'$text=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $projectRoot "$node'"\\display_interface.txt\") -Raw; "'$match=[regex]::Match($text,'"'(?ms)"'^GE1/0/3 current state.*?(?=''^'"\\S+ current state|\\z)'); Write-Output \"["'$node GE1/0/3]"; ($match.Value -split "`r?`n" | Where-Object {$_ -match '"'Last 300 seconds (input|output) rate|Multicast:|utility rate'})}"
